nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, let $\mathcal{O}_d$ be the ring of integers of $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-d})$. The Bianchi group is $\mathrm{PSL}(2, \mathcal{O}_d)$, the projective special linear group of $2 \times 2$ matrices over $\mathcal{O}_d$.
nodes.title: Bianchi group

nodes.summary: The profinite completion of a group $G$ is the inverse limit of the finite quotient groups $G/N$, where $N$ ranges over the normal subgroups of finite index in $G$ and the maps are the quotient maps $G/N \to G/M$ for $N \le M$. It is a profinite group.
nodes.title: Profinite completion

nodes.summary: A group $\Gamma$ is *profinitely rigid* if it is finitely generated and residually finite, and $\Gamma$ is isomorphic to every finitely generated residually finite group $\Lambda$ whose profinite completion is isomorphic, as a group, to the profinite completion of $\Gamma$.
nodes.title: Profinitely rigid group

nodes.summary: For a natural number $d$, the ring of integers of the number field $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-d})$, realized as the splitting field of $X^2 + d$ over $\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: Ring of integers of a field obtained by adjoining a square root to $\mathbb{Q}$

nodes.summary: Let $\omega$ be a primitive cube root of unity, so that the ring $\mathbb{Z}[\omega]$ of Eisenstein integers is the ring of integers of $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-3})$. nodes.title: Profinite rigidity of the Bianchi group over the Eisenstein integers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
